title: Chapter 464: The Great Era Is Coming
content:
Chapter 464: The Great Era Is Coming

"Eternal Continent!"

In the magnificent hall, Yunqi's eyes shone, his fists clenched, and he shouted excitedly: "Can we start fighting again? Hahahaha, it's great."

The others also smiled, full of yearning for the future life.

Seeing everyone's reaction, Lu Daosheng did not stop them.

"There will be some very special strong people on this continent. You may not be the strongest, but I hope that one day in the future, this Eternal Continent can really be unified."

"Do you have confidence?"

Lu Daosheng said slowly, and then looked at everyone.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, everyone shouted in unison: "Don't worry, Lord City Lord, I will live up to your trust!"

"Hahaha."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng couldn't help laughing.

"Go ahead, no matter what method you use, just do it to your heart's content."

"Remember, behind you is the deserted city, and I am Lu Daosheng!"

With a wave of Lu Daosheng's hand, the hall became empty in a moment, leaving only Lu Daosheng sitting alone in the main seat.

After a long silence, Lu Daosheng slowly walked out of the hall, raised his neck slightly and looked up at the sky, with a wanton smile slowly emerging from the corner of his mouth.

"Anyway, the end of this world is destruction, so let's turn this world upside down!"

.........

Since the creation of the Eternal Continent, the former Chaos Realm has also become a part of the Eternal Continent and renamed the Heavenly Domain.

Lu Daosheng also pulled the worlds that were once on the plane here one by one, and turned them into a part of the Heavenly Domain.

After a period of time, the Heavenly Domain will become the center of the Eternal Continent, a holy place longed for by countless creatures.

Here, there are strong people like clouds and resources everywhere.

The opportunity to soar into the sky is real.

Above the Heaven Realm, the Wasteland City is a legendary giant city. Every powerful person who has walked out of it is a peerless powerful person who shakes the world and stirs up the wind and clouds.

However, these are just later stories.

.........

"Dad!"

In front of the gate of the Wasteland City, Lu Xue stood in the void, looking at the direction of the city gate with a nervous expression.

There, a graceful man was walking towards here, with steady steps and a casual look.

"Xiaoxue, are you ready?"

Lu Daosheng walked in front of Lu Xue and asked with a chuckle.

Beside Lu Xue, Yan Lingyun also looked at Lu Xue with a gentle smile.

"Yeah!"

Lu Xue nodded heavily, her eyes full of brilliance.

She felt that she was so happy now.

Her father and mother were going to travel around the entire Eternal Continent. I thought it was a world for the two of them, but I didn't expect that there was a place for her.

She can be with her parents again.

At this time, Lu Xue's sleeves moved, and a head popped out. It was Ao Qing.

As if sensing what Lu Xue was thinking, Ao Qing quickly reminded her: "Young Master, I'm still here. I can accompany you."

"Go, get out of here!"

Lu Xue looked at Ao Qing with disdain, and threw him aside.

"Dad, Mom, let's go!"

Lu Xue took Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun's arms, and her two beautiful big eyes were smiling into a crescent moon.

Lu Daosheng was also in a good mood at the moment, waved his hand, and said: "Let's go, Dad will take you and your mother to have a good time!"

"Young Master! Master! Madam! Wait for me!!!"

Ao Qing chased after the three people, fearing that he would be left behind.

In the years that followed, the three people and the dragon left their own traces in every corner of the Eternal Continent.

.........

Tianyu, in the Human Emperor Palace.

"Master, the seniors in the deserted city have already started to act. Should we also set off?"

Mo Chou looked at the sitting master Wu Hui and said excitedly.

The other strong men of the Human Emperor Palace also looked at Wu Hui with some expectations in their eyes.

Feeling the impatience of the crowd, Wu Hui knew that the great era was coming. The original intention of the establishment of the Human Emperor Palace was to protect the human race and accumulate strength.

Now, he thinks that the strength of the Human Emperor Palace is not weak.

It is time to do something big.

The Eternal Continent is so vast and boundless that there will naturally be many human races. The Human Emperor Palace wants to be the only Human Emperor Palace in the Eternal Continent and command all human forces!

"Master, although I don't know where you are now, I think that one day, you will definitely see the day when the Human Emperor Palace will shock the world."

Wu Hui murmured, then smiled and looked at the strong men of the Human Emperor Palace one by one.

"Then everyone, let's start our own journey."

"I am willing to follow the Lord of the Palace until death!"

On the other side, in the Tian Yao Clan.

"Ancestor, now that the Eternal Continent has appeared, the world must be turbulent and turbulent. How should our Tian Yao Clan stand?"

The Tian Yao Clan leader looked at the ancestor who had come back to life and asked.

Now that Hao Yusheng has returned, the affairs of the Tian Yao Clan will naturally be decided by him.

Hearing this question, Hao Yusheng closed his eyes slightly and fell into thought.

He had seen the strength of the Desolate City, which was simply amazing.

Based on the current Chaos Realm, the Tian Yao Clan is equivalent to leaning on a towering tree. Even if they eat up all the land, they can still live happily and be self-sufficient.

But, Hao and Sheng are not that kind of comfortable person?

"The more chaotic the times are, the more opportunities there will be."

Hao Yusheng sighed lightly and then said, "Since this great era is coming, my Tian Yao Clan naturally cannot be a spectator."

"Transfer my order and gather the powerful Heavenly Demons!"

For a moment, the Tiande Clan also began to restlessness.

It is worth mentioning that the combat power list and the Tianjiao List of Huangcheng are not closed, but continue to operate.

This time, the double list of Huangcheng is not only aimed at the Chaos Realm, but the entire Eternal Continent.

The competition is so fierce that it can be imagined!

.........

On the top of a mountain on the Eternal Continent, a man in martial arts suddenly opened his eyes and stared at the sky.

"It's really surprising that the world will usher in such a change."

Wu Shang spoke slowly, and the hoarse voice echoed on the top of the mountain.

He couldn't help but think of Lu Daosheng's figure.

"I'm afraid there is only one who can do this."

"Haha, disciple, I don't know where you have now."

.........

"The perfect combination of the boundaries of the world is really a skillful task!"

Standing in front of the original world boundary, looking at the place that has been perfectly integrated with another world, peacefully keeping your eyes solemn.

"It seems that Senior Lu has gone back."

Thinking of this, An Chang looked towards the Chaos Realm, and his expression became a little complicated.

"Maybe, it's time for me to go back and have a look."

.........

"Ahem, this change is really God helping me, hahahaha."

A embarrassed figure hid in the void, feeling the changes in the world, and couldn't help but say happily.

It was Huo Xingzhi who had left the Chaos Realm for a long time.

However, at this time, he was not as energetic as he was at the beginning, but instead looked sick and obviously suffered a serious injury.

"I originally thought about where to hide, but now that the worlds are connected, where can I go?"

"Even if you go back to Chaos Realm directly, there is no problem at all, hahaha."

Huo Xingzhi smiled miserably, and then his laughter stopped, "Senior Lu, all this is thanks to you."
